versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the remember-preferences skill.
- Provides a system for recording and recalling user preferences (tone, tools, timing, turn-offs) to personalize agent behavior.
- Requires a BlueColumn API key for storing and retrieving preferences.
- Includes workflow and API examples for capturing, confirming, and applying preferences.
- Full documentation and API reference available at bluecolumn.ai/docs.
